selection_policy: All eligible photographs after common class-scope and quality controls; no class caps and no fixed total
execution_preference: Student runs preparation, notebooks and training; do not execute automatically
interrupted_work: Preparation stopped before publication; waiting training and notebook jobs stopped
previous_outputs: Retired from the active proposal and preserved in ignored local backups and Git history
verification_limits: No claim that the reconstructed full cohort has completed preparation or model evaluation
